description: CA · Government & Defense · sktc.sk.ca zoominfo.com/c/saskatoon-tribal-council-inc/215335121 Saskatoon Tribal Council (STC) is a non-profit tribal council founded in 1982 in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan (Treaty 6), uniting 7 First Nations with 14,000+ members.
